encodes: A candidate set with the correct identifier listed twice, so two candidates open the same commitment.
provenance: x402 offer-receipt extension section 5.6.4, as proposed in pull request 3827 at commit 0e492d6 and not on main

the gap goun7 named on x402-foundation/x402#3379, 19 October 2026: AMBIGUOUS was covered by an in-code test (test/settlement-link-vectors.mjs) but no published vector reached it, so the kanon-shaped corpus had zero ways to be ambiguous against six ways to fail
description: Same real receipt, signature and salt as opens-live.json. The only change is the candidate list, which carries the correct identifier twice instead of once. Both entries compute the same commitment, so the match count is two, and the code treats two the same as zero: fail-closed, never a guess at which one is real. A random 32 byte salt makes two DIFFERENT identifiers colliding on the same commitment practically impossible, so the only realistic trigger for this branch is a duplicate entry in the candidate set itself, which a careless or malicious candidate-set builder can produce without needing a hash collision.

context.note: Same real transaction as opens-live.json. The only change is a duplicated candidate, so this vector isolates the ambiguous branch without inventing a second transaction.
